description: Single-source-of-truth endogenous macroeconomic, demographic, fiscal, and parliamentary feedback parameters for Sandvox CLI (run_simulation.py)

fertility.ed_budget_unit_bn: Cabinet Office 'Children Future Strategy' (こども未来戦略, 2023-12-22): ~3.6-4.5 trillion JPY annual child/education expansion benchmark unit
fertility.ed_tfr_boost_per_unit: IPSS 16th National Fertility Survey (第16回出生動向基本調査, 2022) & Cabinet Office child-rearing educational cost-relief elasticity (~+0.045 TFR per 4.5T JPY)
fertility.discontent_baseline: Calibrated neutral household pressure/discontent median (0.20) at initial 2025-01-01 cohort state (jpn_people_2024.json)
fertility.discontent_tfr_slope: IPSS marriage/birth postponement sensitivity to household economic insecurity (-0.18 TFR per +1.0 median discontent shift)
fertility.food_infl_threshold: MIC CPI food inflation reference threshold (2.5% YoY) above which real household Engel burden compresses marriage/fertility intent
fertility.food_infl_tfr_slope: Engel coefficient & cost-of-living fertility drag (-0.22 TFR per +100% excess food inflation)
fertility.real_wage_tfr_slope: MHLW Monthly Labour Survey (毎月勤労統計調査) real wage elasticity of marriage & first-birth hazard (+0.06)
fertility.stress_drag_min: Lower bound (-0.10 TFR) on short-run macroeconomic cost-of-living drag (preventing unphysical TFR collapse in single shock months)
fertility.stress_drag_max: Upper bound (+0.04 TFR) on macroeconomic real-wage tailwind
fertility.tfr_floor: Demographic lower bound (0.85, comparable to East Asian metropolitan minimum)
fertility.tfr_ceiling: Demographic upper bound (2.05, near replacement fertility 2.07 per IPSS 2023 projections)

migration.structural_baseline: IPSS Population Projections for Japan (日本の将来推計人口 令和5年推計, 2023-04): long-run medium-variant net foreign migration (~164,000-168,000 persons/year)
migration.reopening_decay_years: Half-life decay horizon (12.0 years) normalizing the 2022-2023 post-COVID border reopening surge (242,000/yr, MIC 2023-10) to IPSS structural baseline
migration.cap_ssw_multiplier: ISA (出入国在留管理庁) ratio of total working/accompanying foreign resident capacity to Specified Skilled Worker (特定技能) visa cap (1.5x)
migration.cap_saturation_scale: Long-horizon social/absorption infrastructure scale (8,000,000 additional foreign residents) for logistic headroom saturation
migration.cap_headroom_floor: Minimum replacement/renewal inflow ratio (0.35) when foreign resident stock approaches statutory visa ceiling
migration.infl_attract_threshold: Domestic CPI inflation threshold (3.0%) above which real purchasing power erosion reduces destination attractiveness
migration.infl_attract_slope: Exchange-rate/purchasing-power elasticity of net migration inflow to excess domestic inflation (-2.5)
migration.discontent_attract_threshold: Social discontent threshold (0.22) above which labor-market/living-cost friction dampens net inflow
migration.discontent_attract_slope: Sensitivity of net migration inflow to excess domestic discontent (-0.6)
migration.real_wage_attract_slope: Elasticity of net foreign worker inflow to real after-tax wage ratio (+0.15)

fiscal_and_jgb.old_75plus_cost_weight: MHLW National Medical Care Expenditure (令和4年度 国民医療費の概況, 2024) & Long-Term Care Insurance Report: per-capita medical + nursing expenditure ratio for ages 75+ (~940k+ JPY) vs. 65-74 (~270k-350k JPY), ~3.5x
fiscal_and_jgb.senior_relief_multiplier: Fiscal relief multiplier (2.5) from active 65-74 employment (pension_age extension) reducing net pension drawdown & increasing social insurance contributions
fiscal_and_jgb.senior_relief_floor: Maximum proportional reduction floor (0.70) on social security budget from senior employment extension
fiscal_and_jgb.care_dependency_elasticity: MHLW Long-Term Care & Social Security dependency elasticity (0.85): formal care & benefit utilization response to old-age dependency ratio (B_t/L_t), bounded by Macroeconomic Slide (国民年金法第27条の3) as total population shrinks
fiscal_and_jgb.core_ops_pop_elasticity: Share (0.55) of non-social-security core administrative & public-works maintenance expenditure scaling with national population vs. fixed sovereign overhead (0.45)
fiscal_and_jgb.infl_index_threshold: BoJ Price Stability Target (物価安定の目標 2.0%, 2013-01): baseline inflation already embedded in initial fiscal trend
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_infl_threshold: BoJ 2.0% inflation target anchor for 10Y JGB nominal yield
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_infl_slope: Fisher-effect / BoJ policy rate pass-through into 10Y JGB yield above 2% inflation (0.45)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_debt_gdp_slope: Sovereign term-premium sensitivity per +100% Debt/GDP above FY2024 baseline (+80 bps per 1.0 Debt/GDP, IMF/OECD Japan fiscal risk literature)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_bond_dep_threshold: MOF General Account bond dependency (公債依存度) normal threshold (35.0%, vs FY2024 baseline 31.5%)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_bond_dep_slope: Primary market absorption spread above 35% bond dependency (0.035)
fiscal_and_jgb.crisis_bond_dep_threshold: Severe fiscal stress threshold (45.0% bond dependency, comparable to FY2009/FY2020 crisis issuance peaks)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_crisis_slope: Non-linear sovereign risk premium slope when bond dependency exceeds 45% (0.15)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_min: Effective lower bound on 10Y JGB yield (0.50%)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_max: Institutional/BoJ yield-curve backstop ceiling on 10Y JGB yield (5.50%)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_adjust_days: Quarterly market yield adjustment time constant (90.0 days)
fiscal_and_jgb.jgb_rollover_years: MOF Debt Management Report 2024 (債務管理リポート 2024): average maturity of outstanding JGB stock (~8.5-9.2 years), governing refinancing pass-through from market yield to effective coupon rate
fiscal_and_jgb.crisis_infl_premium: Fiscal dominance / currency depreciation CPI inflation premium during >45% bond dependency crisis (+3.0%/yr)
fiscal_and_jgb.crisis_food_premium: Imported food & energy cost pass-through premium during fiscal/FX stress (+4.0%/yr)
fiscal_and_jgb.vat_food_passthrough: Consumption tax hike pass-through into retail food prices (0.80, accounting for reduced-rate/input-cost channels)
fiscal_and_jgb.vat_ongoing_food_bite: Persistent real household purchasing-power bite of higher consumption tax rate on food budget (0.35)

persons_replenishment.min_sample_ratio: Minimum headcount retention ratio (0.60) for household-tier mode before cohort replenishment
persons_replenishment.min_effective_sample_ratio: Kish (1965) Effective Sample Size ratio threshold (N_eff / N_eff_0 = 0.55) triggering generational cohort resampling when reweighting across aging/reborn cells concentrates sample weights
persons_replenishment.max_age_l1_divergence: Maximum L1 total variation distance (0.20) between unweighted sample age-bracket shares and live national cohort shares before resampling
persons_replenishment.min_replenish_interval_months: Minimum generational cooldown (120 months = 10 years) between cohort replenishments

polity_feedback.pr_vote_share_memory: Persistence weight (0.70) on prior proportional representation baseline when updating party support after national elections (0.30 weight on realized swing)
polity_feedback.party_share_floor: Minimum proportional vote share floor (0.015) preserving multi-party representation across century-long horizons
polity_feedback.new_cabinet_approval_init: Initial cabinet approval baseline (0.42, NHK post-designation historical honeymoon average) upon constitutional Prime Minister alternation (Constitution Art. 67)
